source.name: Epoch AI
source.description: Epoch AI Benchmarking Hub: Epoch's own evaluation runs (FrontierMath, SimpleQA Verified).
source.attribution: Epoch AI, 'Capabilities & benchmarking'. Published online at epoch.ai. Retrieved from 'https://epoch.ai/benchmarks'.
notes: Score = Epoch's 'Best score (across scorers)', converted from 0-1 to 0-100; mean_score and stderr in extra.
evaluation_date = the run's start date. Model names from Epoch's model_metadata (model_group).
Only Epoch-run files are included; *_external.csv files (e.g. ARC-AGI) keep their publishers' original licensing and are not part of this file.
